ada:fundingSourceForAnalysis: M.S.N.: Educorp (Unicamp) and International Association of Geoanalysts for Geoanalysis 2022 presentation; J.E.: CNPq grant 316191/2021-3
ada:detectionLimit: LODs in µg g⁻¹ (median from Table 3): As 2, Au 0.1, Co 2, Cr 19, Cu 0.8, Fe 5300, Ga 0.1, Ge 0.2, Ir 0.04, Ni 60, Os 0.09, Pd 0.06, Pt 0.4, Re 0.02, Rh 0.05, Ru 0.3, W 0.09; calculated per Longerich et al. (1996) in iolite 4
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: RSD <15% for most elements in Arraias meteorite under repeatability conditions (n=20 spot analyses); Cr: 20%, Ir: 16%, Os: 20% RSD; assessed by repeated analysis of same meteorite in one session
ada:betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAnd: Intermediate precision: RSD ≤20% for most elements assessed over multiple days on North Chile iron meteorite measured as unknown (n multiple days over 4 months)
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Results for 9 known iron meteorites: >75% of published values within LA-ICP-MS result ± 2s (two standard deviations); relative differences mostly within ±20% (Fig. 2); specific discrepancies: Ir in Arraias +40%, Ir in Nossa Senhora +64%, Co and Ga in Campo del Cielo (heterogeneity issues); trend lines slope 0.87–1.17 with R² = 0.97–1.0

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: In situ — polished epoxy mount (~1 cm fragments in epoxy, etched with Nital)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Fragments ~1 cm mounted in epoxy resin, polished, cleaned with ultrapure water

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: He: 0.6 l min⁻¹ (MFC 1) + 0.7 l min⁻¹ (MFC 2) in HelEx II cell; combined with Ar makeup via T-piece near torch

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Ar make-up gas (combined via T-piece in sample transport line near torch; flow rate not stated separately)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Plasma gas: 16 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary: 0.9 l min⁻¹; Nebulizer gas (from table): 1.1 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: ICP and laser settings optimized daily for optimum signal intensity and low oxide formation (factory specifications; mass calibration and detector cross-calibration checked and redone if required)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NIST SRM 612(×3) → North Chile(×3) → unknowns(×10) → NIST SRM 612(×2) → North Chile(×2) → unknowns(×10) → … (bracketing every 15)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Dwell Time per Mass
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 0.02 s per isotope; 100 samples per peak; 10 runs; 60 passes; total measurement time 120 s per analysis

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Applied: triple mode detector (pulse counting, analog, Faraday); low relative abundance isotopes chosen for Ni and Fe to allow analog mode measurement of major matrix elements

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Fe+Ni+Co=100% sum normalization applied in iolite 3D Trace Elements DRS as final step; yield correction factors applied for NIST SRM 612 relative to North Chile

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: NIST SRM 612 glass (Jochum et al. 2011) + North Chile Filomena iron meteorite (Wasson et al. 1989) — used together with yield correction in iolite 3D DRS

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: North Chile Filomena measured as unknown on different days over 4 months to assess intermediate precision (Table 3 and Fig. 2)
